attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Wisconsin state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per WI tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Wisconsin Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Wisconsin tax - Single filer (progressive brackets)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.wi_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max /wi_taxable_income xdef
0 /wi_tax xdef
wi_taxable_income result.wi_bracket_1_limit_single min result.wi_bracket_1_rate mul wi_tax add /wi_tax xdef
wi_taxable_income result.wi_bracket_1_limit_single gt { wi_taxable_income result.wi_bracket_2_limit_single min result.wi_bracket_1_limit_single sub 0 max result.wi_bracket_2_rate mul wi_tax add /wi_tax xdef } if
wi_taxable_income result.wi_bracket_2_limit_single gt { wi_taxable_income result.wi_bracket_3_limit_single min result.wi_bracket_2_limit_single sub 0 max result.wi_bracket_3_rate mul wi_tax add /wi_tax xdef } if
wi_taxable_income result.wi_bracket_3_limit_single gt { wi_taxable_income result.wi_bracket_3_limit_single sub result.wi_bracket_4_rate mul wi_tax add /wi_tax xdef } if
wi_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Wisconsin tax (Single) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
